# Synthesis Summary — Term Outlook Fixture

## Top Findings

Multi-year electoral outlook spanning from Q1 2026 to the next European Parliament election (June 2029): coalition trajectory, mandate delivery progress, Spitzenkandidaten early signals, and seat-projection bands at 6/12/24/36-month intervals.

## Term Trajectory

EP10 (2024–2029) enters its second legislative year with the EPP-S&D-Renew centrist bloc structurally intact but showing marginal cohesion erosion on defence and migration. Far-right ECR-PfE bloc consolidating opposition capacity.

## Electoral Signals

No declared Spitzenkandidaten at 36 months pre-election. EPP internal primary process expected to begin H2 2027. S&D exploring cross-progressive alliance architecture.
